summary: FEMSA (Mexican Economic Development Inc., NYSE: FMX; BMV: FEMSAUBD) filed a Form 6-K announcing an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement with a U.S. financial institution, its equivalent of a US issuer buyback disclosure. FEMSA will repurchase up to USD 280 million of American Depositary Shares, each ADS representing 10 BD Units, with the final share count based on the daily volume-weighted average ADS price during the term less a discount, subject to market conditions and delivered at maturity. Final settlement is expected before year-end 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee was disclosed; watch execution pace, discount and any incremental buyback authorization.
